notes.zh:
- 修复 MagicOS（荣耀 MagicOS 10）无线调试连接/配对超时：连接跟随 mDNS 公告地址并回环兜底，配对失败在界面显示底层原因
- shell 权限：中途退出设置页后状态不再卡在「正在启动 / 正在发现配对服务」
- 修复悬浮球无法唤醒的问题
- SecretId 输入框显示掩码
notes.en:
- Fix wireless debugging pairing/connect timeout on MagicOS (Honor MagicOS 10): connect to the mDNS-advertised address with loopback fallback, and surface the underlying failure in the UI
- Shell access: the state no longer sticks at "Starting / Discovering pairing service" after leaving the settings page mid-flight
- Fix the floating ball not waking the assistant
- Mask the SecretId input field
